settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.description: Have a question? We're here to help.

settings.title: When will my order arrive?
settings.text: All orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Delivery across Pakistan usually takes 2-4 working days depending on your location.

settings.title: Are your products safe for sensitive skin?
settings.text: Yes, all Dr. Romelia products are dermatologically tested, cruelty-free, and formulated to be gentle on all skin types, including sensitive skin.

settings.title: How can I track my order?
settings.text: Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a WhatsApp message with your tracking details.
